Name: Create a booking with valid data
Objective: Check that a booking with all required fields is created and returned with its id.
Precondition: The Restful-Booker API is reachable (local Docker instance or public instance).
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Send POST /booking.
Test Data: Headers: Content-Type: application/json, Accept: application/json. Body: firstname "Jim", lastname "Brown", totalprice 111, depositpaid true, checkin "2026-01-01", checkout "2026-01-02", additionalneeds "<request> - qa-portfolio run <YYMMDD_HHMMSS>"
Expected Result: Status 200. bookingid is a positive integer. booking echoes every field sent, additionalneeds included.

Name: Read a booking by id
Objective: Check that a created booking can be read back by its id with the same data.
Precondition: The Restful-Booker API is reachable (local Docker instance or public instance). A booking was created and its bookingid is known.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Send GET /booking/{bookingid}.
Expected Result: Status 200. firstname, lastname, totalprice, depositpaid, checkin and checkout equal the created values.

Name: Find a booking by guest name
Objective: Check that the booking id list can be filtered by guest first and last name.
Precondition: The Restful-Booker API is reachable (local Docker instance or public instance). A booking for Jim Brown was created and its bookingid is known.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Send GET /booking with query parameters firstname and lastname.
Expected Result: Status 200. The returned list contains the created bookingid.

Name: Reject a booking with a missing required field
Objective: Check that a booking without a required field is refused as a client error.
Precondition: The Restful-Booker API is reachable (local Docker instance or public instance).
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Send POST /booking without the firstname field.
Test Data: Headers: Content-Type: application/json, Accept: application/json. Body: the valid body without firstname
Expected Result: Status 400 with a message naming the missing field. Current behaviour: 500 Internal Server Error (BUG-002).

Name: Reject a malformed JSON body
Objective: Check that a syntactically invalid JSON body is refused.
Precondition: The Restful-Booker API is reachable (local Docker instance or public instance).
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Send POST /booking with a truncated JSON body.
Test Data: Headers: Content-Type: application/json, Accept: application/json. Body: {"firstname":
Expected Result: Status 400, body "Bad Request".

Name: Return 404 for an unknown or non-numeric id
Objective: Check that reading a booking that does not exist returns Not Found.
Precondition: The Restful-Booker API is reachable (local Docker instance or public instance).
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Send GET /booking/abc.
Expected Result: Status 404, body "Not Found".

Name: Get a token with valid credentials
Objective: Check that valid credentials return an authentication token.
Precondition: The Restful-Booker API is reachable (local Docker instance or public instance).
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Send POST /auth.
Test Data: Header: Content-Type: application/json. Body: username "admin", password "password123" (public demo credentials)
Expected Result: Status 200. token is present and alphanumeric.

Name: Refuse a token for bad credentials
Objective: Check that bad credentials are refused and no token is returned.
Precondition: The Restful-Booker API is reachable (local Docker instance or public instance).
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Send POST /auth with a wrong password.
Test Data: Header: Content-Type: application/json. Body: username "admin", password "not-the-password"
Expected Result: Status 401 and no token in the body. Current behaviour: 200 with {"reason":"Bad credentials"} (BUG-001).

Name: Update a booking with a valid token
Objective: Check that an authenticated client can replace a booking.
Precondition: The Restful-Booker API is reachable (local Docker instance or public instance). A booking exists and a valid token was obtained.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Send PUT /booking/{bookingid} with the token cookie.
Test Data: Headers: Content-Type: application/json, Accept: application/json, Cookie: token=<token>. Body: Same body as at creation, with firstname "James" and totalprice 222
Expected Result: Status 200. The returned booking has firstname "James" and totalprice 222, other fields unchanged.

Name: Partially update a booking with a valid token
Objective: Check that PATCH changes only the fields sent.
Precondition: The Restful-Booker API is reachable (local Docker instance or public instance). A booking with firstname "James" exists and a valid token was obtained.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Send PATCH /booking/{bookingid} with the token cookie.
Test Data: Headers: Content-Type: application/json, Accept: application/json, Cookie: token=<token>. Body: totalprice 333
Expected Result: Status 200. totalprice is 333 and firstname is still "James".

Name: Refuse an update without a token or with an invalid token
Objective: Check that an unauthenticated update is refused.
Precondition: The Restful-Booker API is reachable (local Docker instance or public instance). A booking exists.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Send PUT /booking/{bookingid} without any token.
Test Data: Headers: Content-Type: application/json, Accept: application/json. Body: Same body as at creation, with firstname "James" and totalprice 222
Expected Result: Status 403, body "Forbidden".

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Send the same request with an invalid token.
Expected Result: Status 403, body "Forbidden".

Name: Delete a booking with a valid token
Objective: Check that an authenticated client can delete a booking and that it is gone.
Precondition: The Restful-Booker API is reachable (local Docker instance or public instance). A booking exists and a valid token was obtained.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Send DELETE /booking/{bookingid} with the token cookie.
Expected Result: Status 204 No Content. Current behaviour: 201 Created, body "Created" (BUG-003).

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Send GET /booking/{bookingid}.
Expected Result: Status 404, body "Not Found".

Name: Refuse a delete without a token
Objective: Check that an unauthenticated delete is refused.
Precondition: The Restful-Booker API is reachable (local Docker instance or public instance). A booking exists.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Send DELETE /booking/{bookingid} without any token.
Expected Result: Status 403, body "Forbidden".

Name: Return 404 when acting on a deleted booking
Objective: Check that a deleted booking is reported as not found for every method.
Precondition: The Restful-Booker API is reachable (local Docker instance or public instance). A booking was deleted and a valid token was obtained.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Send DELETE /booking/{bookingid} again with the token cookie.
Expected Result: Status 404. Current behaviour: 405 Method Not Allowed (BUG-004).

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Send PUT /booking/{bookingid} with the token cookie.
Test Data: Headers: Content-Type: application/json, Accept: application/json, Cookie: token=<token>. Body: Same body as at creation, with firstname "James" and totalprice 222
Expected Result: Status 404. Current behaviour: 405 Method Not Allowed (BUG-004).

Objective: Check that a locked-out user cannot log in and is told why.

Expected Result: The Login form is displayed.

Expected Result: The error "Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out." is displayed. The user stays on the login page.

Name: Wrong password is refused
Objective: Check that a wrong password is refused.
Precondition: The SauceDemo site https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable. Browser: chromium or firefox.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Open the login page.
Expected Result: The Login form is displayed.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter the credentials and click Login.
Expected Result: The error "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service" is displayed. The user stays on the login page.

Name: Buy two products with consistent totals
Objective: Check the full purchase flow and that the overview totals are computed correctly.
Precondition: The SauceDemo site https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable. Browser: chromium or firefox. Logged in as standard_user, cart empty.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Click "Add to cart" on the first product.
Expected Result: The button becomes "Remove". The cart badge shows 1.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Click "Add to cart" on the second product.
Expected Result: The button becomes "Remove". The cart badge shows 2.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Open the cart.
Expected Result: Title "Your Cart". Both products are listed, in the order added.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Click Checkout.
Expected Result: Title "Checkout: Your Information".

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Fill the customer information.
Test Data: First Name: Jane. Last Name: Doe. Zip/Postal Code: 75001
Expected Result: The three fields hold the values entered.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Click Continue.
Expected Result: Title "Checkout: Overview". One price line per product.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Check the totals.
Expected Result: Item total = sum of the product prices. Tax = item total x 8 %, rounded to the cent. Total = item total + tax.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Click Finish.
Expected Result: URL ends with /checkout-complete.html. Heading "Thank you for your order!". The cart badge is gone.

Name: Checkout information is required
Objective: Check that the checkout cannot continue without customer information.
Precondition: The SauceDemo site https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable. Browser: chromium or firefox. Logged in as standard_user, cart empty.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Add one product to the cart, open the cart and click Checkout.
Expected Result: Title "Checkout: Your Information". The cart badge shows 1.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Click Continue with all fields empty.
Test Data: First Name, Last Name, Zip/Postal Code: empty
Expected Result: The error "Error: First Name is required" is displayed. The user stays on "Checkout: Your Information".
